title: Balanced Tofu Red Curry Noodles
subtitle: with Kale and Coconut Crunch
description: Like your veggie curries a little on the spicy side? Well, this one's for you! Kale, smoky tofu and noodles come together in a creamy Thai red curry, with a sprinkle of toasted coconut to finish.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles. Thinly slice the onion. Remove the tough inner stems from the kale, then coarsely chop the leaves. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove.

Cook noodles: Cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 7 mins or until tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking. Meanwhile, put the coconut and garlic in a cold medium deep frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan. Wipe the pan clean with paper towel.

Fry tofu and onion: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the same pan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden. Remove from the pan. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion, stirring regularly, for 3 mins or until softened. Add the curry paste (see Make it yours) and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant.

Simmer curry: Add the coconut milk, 2 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp honey and 180ml (¾ cup) water to the onion mixture. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook for 5 mins or until the sauce is slightly thickened.

Serve up: Meanwhile, thinly slice the tofu. Add the kale to the curry and cook, stirring, for 2 mins. Add the tofu and cook for a further 1-2 mins until the kale is wilted and the tofu is warmed through. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the noodles and curry among bowls, scatter over the coconut mixture and enjoy!
Make it yours: Not a fan of too much spice? The beauty of this recipe is that it can easily be adapted to suit your taste. Simply add half the curry paste for a milder version!
